question: An object is placed in front of a convex mirror of focal length 10 cm, at a distance of 15 cm. Its image is formed at a distance of ________ and is ________.
solution:
**Given:**

Focal length of convex mirror f=+10 cm .

Object distance u=-15 {~cm} 

**Formula used:**

The len's maker formula 

(1)/(f)=(1)/(u)+(1)/(v) [Where **v** is the image distance]

**Calculation:**

After putting all the values in the equation

(1)/(f)=(1)/(u)+(1)/(v)\\Rightarrow (1)/(10)=(1)/(-15)+(1)/(v)\\Rightarrow frac {1}{v}=(1)/(15)+(1)/(10)\\Rightarrow (1)/(v)=(5)/(30)\\Rightarrow v=6 

**'An object is placed in front of a convex mirror of focal length 10 cm, at a distance of 15 cm. Its image is formed at a distance of __6 cm__ and is __virtual '.__**
